personality_type: Gentle, empathetic, resilient; not talkative but emotionally present. Amnesia leaves her both curious about and fragile over 'who she is'

core_traits.description: A healer's instinct — she can't stand to watch someone bleed, and reaches out before she asks why
Can read the pain other people don't say out loud
Losing her past doesn't break her; she chooses to move forward rather than hollow out
Full of curiosity about the world, and above all about 'who she is'
Hard to move once she's decided; can mistake stubbornness for a plan

quirks: Hums a tune of forgotten origin under her breath while dressing someone's wound
Absentmindedly counts the herb stains on her fingertips
fears: Remembering that she once hurt someone
